newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange ends higher.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange ends higher.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange ended the week higher on Friday, with market heavyweight Ashanti Goldfields Company AGC.GH and Pioneer Tobacco Company the only advancing issues, its market report showed.
The All-Share index closed 0.73 points higher at 367.22 points. Last Friday, the index closed at 362.88 points.
Just 15,510 shares were traded. Bids outstripped offers by 2,068,710 to 365,510.
Ashanti rose 150 cedis to 21,500 cedis, Pioneer Tobacco 10 cedis to 205.
The lone declining issue was pharmaceutical and trading company Paterson Zochonis, which shed one cedi to 249.
Main risers on the week included Aluworks (+100 to 1,200) and Ghana Commercial Bank (+20 to 600).
